prosa.sem_intervalos: No prediction intervals, and therefore no forecast calibration. All five models here produce point forecasts, and all three metrics are point-forecast metrics. What we quantified is the uncertainty of the accuracy metric, not the uncertainty of an individual forecast. Empirical coverage against a nominal level was therefore never assessed. For a manager sizing capacity, the interval is the operative quantity, and its absence is the most consequential gap in this work. Enabling the intervals each model already supports natively and measuring coverage by horizon is the immediate next step.
prosa.prophet_sem_exogena: Prophet and TimesFM do not accept exogenous regressors in this implementation and were excluded from this comparison rather than being given an input they would ignore.
prosa.periodo_pandemia: Pandemic period. The series includes COVID-19, which introduced level shifts and possible cause-of-death misclassification.
